en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large stone building with distinct Nordic or Baltic architectural features, including a steep gabled roof, narrow vertical windows, and a unique cylindrical turret. There appears to be a coat of arms above the main entrance and some sparse urban surroundings. There is a signature or name ('S. Porkojt' or similar) in the bottom right corner.
